Bosentan has an established role in pulmonary hypertension secondary to scleroderma (p.1817) or other con- nective tissue disorders, but may also have additional benefits. Several case reports1-3 have suggested that treatment with bosen- tan may be associated with healing of refractory digital ulcers in patients with scleroderma, and a controlled study4 found that bosentan reduced the incidence of new digital ulcers, although there was no improvement in the healing of existing ulcers.
